project.name: Ledgerly
project.descriptor: Intelligent Accounting and Business Management System — a scalable, modular ERP and intelligent financial management platform.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to create and configure a company profile.
The system must support the creation and maintenance of a chart of accounts.
The system must allow users to create manual journal entries following debit and credit rules.
The system must post transactions to the general ledger.
The system must generate a trial balance from posted transactions.
The system must produce basic financial statements, including an income statement and balance sheet.
The system must ensure all posted transactions follow balanced debit and credit rules.
The system must provide an audit trail for all financial transactions.
The system must validate transactions for balanced entries, valid accounts, and accounting periods before posting.
The system must support importing and exporting data via Excel or CSV files.
The system must allow for user roles and permissions management.
The system must provide dashboards for operational and financial reporting.
The system must support customer and vendor management.
The system must handle accounts receivable and payable.
The system must manage sales, purchasing, and expenses.
The system must manage cash and bank transactions.
The system must support inventory management.
The system must support budgeting and cost centers.
The system must support branch management for multi-branch operations.
The system must provide AI-assisted financial analysis and insights.
AI-generated analysis must not alter authoritative accounting records without user approval.

stories.title: Create and configure a company profile
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to set up a company profile so that I can begin managing its financial data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new company setup request, when I enter company details, then the system creates a company profile.
Given an incomplete company setup request, when I try to save, then the system prompts for missing information.
Trust: All company setup actions are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Create and maintain a chart of accounts
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to manage the chart of accounts so that I can organize financial transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request to add an account, when I provide valid account details, then the system adds it to the chart of accounts.
Given a request to add an account with invalid details, when I try to save, then the system rejects the request.
Trust: All changes to the chart of accounts are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Create manual journal entries
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to create journal entries so that I can record financial transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journal entry request, when I enter valid debit and credit amounts, then the system records the entry.
Given an unbalanced journal entry request, when I try to save, then the system rejects the entry.
Trust: All journal entries are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Post transactions to the general ledger
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to post transactions to the general ledger so that financial records are updated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid transaction, when I post it, then the system updates the general ledger.
Given an invalid transaction, when I try to post, then the system rejects the posting.
Trust: All postings to the general ledger are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Generate a trial balance
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to generate a trial balance so that I can verify the accuracy of financial records.
acceptance_criteria: Given posted transactions, when I generate a trial balance, then the system displays the balance.
Given no transactions, when I generate a trial balance, then the system shows a zero balance.
Trust: Trial balance generation is logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Produce financial statements
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to produce financial statements so that I can report on the company's financial status.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request for financial statements, when I generate them, then the system produces an income statement and balance sheet.
Given incomplete data, when I try to generate financial statements, then the system alerts me to missing information.
Trust: Financial statement generation is logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Ensure transactions follow balanced debit and credit rules
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want the system to ensure all transactions follow balanced debit and credit rules, so that financial integrity is maintained.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction with balanced debit and credit entries, when I post the transaction, then it should be accepted.
Given a transaction with unbalanced debit and credit entries, when I attempt to post the transaction, then it should be rejected with an error message.
Trust: All transaction attempts must be logged with their success or failure status.

stories.title: Provide an audit trail for all financial transactions
stories.narrative: As an auditor, I want the system to provide an audit trail for all financial transactions, so that I can verify transaction history and integrity.
acceptance_criteria: Given a posted transaction, when I view the audit trail, then it should display the transaction details and status.
Given a failed transaction attempt, when I view the audit trail, then it should display the attempt details and failure reason.
Trust: The audit trail must record every transaction attempt with a timestamp and user ID.

stories.title: Manage customer and vendor profiles
stories.narrative: As a business manager, I want to manage customer and vendor profiles so that I can track business relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new customer profile request, when I enter valid details, then the system saves the profile.
Given an invalid customer profile request, when I try to save, then the system rejects the request.
Trust: All changes to customer and vendor profiles are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Handle accounts receivable and payable
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to manage accounts receivable and payable so that I can track incoming and outgoing payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice, when I mark it as paid, then the system updates accounts receivable.
Given a payment error, when I try to process, then the system alerts me to the issue.
Trust: All accounts receivable and payable transactions are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Manage sales and purchasing workflows
stories.narrative: As a sales manager, I want to manage sales and purchasing workflows so that I can streamline operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales order, when I process it, then the system updates inventory and sales records.
Given an invalid sales order, when I try to process, then the system rejects the order.
Trust: All sales and purchasing transactions are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Manage cash and bank transactions
stories.narrative: As a financial manager, I want to manage cash and bank transactions so that I can maintain accurate cash flow records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank transaction, when I reconcile it, then the system updates cash records.
Given a reconciliation error, when I try to process, then the system alerts me to the issue.
Trust: All cash and bank transactions are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Implement user roles and permissions management
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to manage user roles and permissions, so that access to system features is controlled.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user role, when I assign permissions, then the user should only access allowed features.
Given a user with no permissions, when they attempt to access a feature, then access should be denied.
Trust: All changes to user roles and permissions must be logged with the admin's user ID.

stories.title: Manage inventory
stories.narrative: As an inventory manager, I want to manage inventory so that I can track stock levels and movements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock update, when I enter valid details, then the system updates inventory records.
Given an invalid stock update, when I try to save, then the system rejects the update.
Trust: All inventory changes are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Support budgeting and cost centers
stories.narrative: As a financial planner, I want to manage budgets and cost centers so that I can control spending and allocate resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a budget allocation, when I enter valid details, then the system saves the budget.
Given an invalid budget allocation, when I try to save, then the system rejects the allocation.
Trust: All budget and cost center changes are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Manage branch operations
stories.narrative: As a branch manager, I want to manage branch operations so that I can oversee multi-branch activities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a branch update, when I enter valid details, then the system updates branch records.
Given an invalid branch update, when I try to save, then the system rejects the update.
Trust: All branch changes are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Provide advanced dashboards and reporting
stories.narrative: As a business analyst, I want advanced dashboards and reporting so that I can gain insights into business performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dashboard request, when I configure it, then the system displays the dashboard with real-time data.
Given a reporting error, when I try to generate a report, then the system alerts me to the issue.
Trust: All dashboard configurations and report generations are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Integrate AI for financial insights
stories.narrative: As a financial analyst, I want AI-generated insights so that I can make informed financial decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a financial query, when I request AI analysis, then the system provides insights without altering records.
Given an AI analysis error, when I try to generate insights, then the system alerts me to the issue.
Trust: All AI analysis requests are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Support multi-branch operations
stories.narrative: As a regional manager, I want to support multi-branch operations so that I can manage regional activities effectively.
acceptance_criteria: Given a multi-branch setup request, when I configure branches, then the system supports multi-branch operations.
Given an invalid branch configuration, when I try to save, then the system rejects the configuration.
Trust: All multi-branch configurations are logged in the audit trail.

stories.title: Implement data import/export functionality
stories.narrative: As an accountant, I want to import and export data via Excel or CSV, so that I can move data in and out of the system.
acceptance_criteria: Data can be imported and exported via Excel or CSV.

guardrails.statement: The system must ensure all posted transactions follow balanced debit and credit rules.
The system must provide an audit trail for all financial transactions.
The system must validate transactions for balanced entries, valid accounts, and accounting periods before posting.
AI-generated analysis must not alter authoritative accounting records without user approval.
